arxiv.title: Scalable Behavior Cloning with Open Data, Training, and Evaluation
arxiv.abstract: We introduce ABC, a fully open-source stack for manipulation with behavior cloning. At its core is ABC-130K: the largest open-source teleoperation dataset to date, featuring 3,500 hours of data spanning over 130K episodes across 195 diverse tasks. arxiv.abstract: Going beyond predicting robot actions, World Action Models (WAMs) can also generate future visual observations. arxiv.title: RouterVLA: Turning Smoke Tests into Supervision for Heterogeneous VLA Selection
arxiv.abstract: We study whether pre-deployment evaluation rollouts can be reused to supervise policy selection. Robot teams routinely smoke test candidate vision-language-action (VLA) policies, then compress those trials into a global winner. arxiv.title: Continual Robot Policy Learning via Variational Neural Dynamics
arxiv.abstract: Robots deployed in the real world rarely operate under a single fixed dynamics model: wind changes, payloads vary, batteries drain, contacts shift, and hardware wears. arxiv.abstract: Autonomous drone racing is a fundamentally challenging regime for autonomous aerial robots, requiring time-optimal control while operating under persistent actuation saturation. arxiv.abstract: Dexterous manipulation depends on contact events that are fast, local, and often visually occluded. Piezoelectric microphones offer a compact and high-bandwidth way to sense these interactions, but the resulting vibro-acoustic signals are difficult to simulate faithfully enough for end-to-end sim-to-real policy learning on dexterous robot hands. arxiv.abstract: We present OctoSense, an open-source sensor platform with stereo RGB and event cameras, LiDAR, a thermal camera, an inertial measurement unit, RTK-corrected global positioning system, and proprioception (CAN bus data from a car, and joint angles for a quadruped robot). arxiv.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are commonly pretrained on robot demonstrations by jointly mapping visual observations and language instructions to actions. arxiv.abstract: This paper presents BOWConnect, a bidirectional parallel kinodynamic motion planner that addresses three fundamental limitations of existing sampling-based methods: sample inefficiency in high-dimensional state spaces, unreliable cost heuristics under dynamic constraints, and poor performance in narrow passage environments. arxiv.abstract: Modern image generation demands a single model that unifies diverse capabilities, including text-to-image (T2I), local editing, and global editing. arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for training LLMs typically rely on ground-truth answers to assign rewards, limiting their applicability to tasks where the ground-truth solution is unknown. arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to screen and rank job applicants, creating incentives for candidates to strategically manipulate algorithmic hiring systems. arxiv.abstract: Mechanistic epidemiological models are widely used to support infectious disease forecasting and public-health decision making. Bayesian calibration of such models is commonly performed using Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), which can become computationally expensive for high-dimensional nonlinear systems and repeated near-real-time analyses. items.title: ABC：完全开源的行为克隆操作栈 + 13 万条遥操作数据集
items.summary: 提出 ABC 开源操作栈，核心是 ABC-130K——迄今最大开源遥操作数据集，含 3500 小时、超 13 万 episode。为 VLA/模仿学习提供了稀缺的大规模开放数据基座。

items.title: RouterVLA：把 smoke test 变成异构 VLA 选择的监督信号
items.summary: 机器人团队部署前常对候选 VLA 策略做 smoke test，RouterVLA 复用这些评估 rollout 来监督策略选择，把一次性测试数据转化为可学习的路由信号。

items.title: LA4VLA：用语言-动作预训练实现「不看也能动」
items.summary: 指出 VLA 预训练中密集视觉-动作监督会压制语言-动作关联，提出语言-动作预训练路线，提升指令泛化能力。

items.title: VibeAct：用振动信号驱动接触丰富的反应式灵巧操作
items.summary: 灵巧操作依赖快速、局部且常被视觉遮挡的接触事件。VibeAct 用压电麦克风采集振动-声学信号作为高带宽接触感知，弥补纯视觉在 contact-rich 任务中的不足。

items.title: 基于变分神经动力学的持续机器人策略学习
items.summary: 真实部署中动力学持续变化（风、负载、电量、接触、磨损），而多数控制器只训练一次。该工作用变分神经动力学做持续策略学习，提升对动力学漂移的适应性。

domains.name: 具身模型（世界模型 / 人形策略 / 基础模型）

items.title: 世界模型的幻觉是可预测、可预防的
items.summary: 生成式世界模型 rollout 视觉流畅却常偏离真实动力学（幻觉）。该工作提出幻觉可预测并给出预防方法，对依赖世界模型做规划/想象的具身系统很关键。

items.title: World Action Models + 循环生成回放实现持续模仿学习
items.summary: WAM 不仅预测动作还能生成未来视觉观测；REGEN 利用这一生成能力做循环生成回放，实现抗遗忘的持续模仿学习。

domains.name: 具身智能芯片（机器人计算 / 边缘 NPU）

items.title: OctoSense：多模态机器人感知的自监督开源传感平台
items.summary: 开源传感平台，集成立体 RGB+事件相机、LiDAR、热成像、IMU、RTK-GPS 及本体感知（CAN 总线），并用自监督学习融合多模态——为机器人边缘感知-计算栈提供硬件参考。

highlights: 开源数据破局：ABC-130K 放出 3500 小时、13 万 episode 遥操作数据集，是本周对 VLA/模仿学习最有分量的开放基座。
世界模型可靠性：「世界模型幻觉可预测可预防」给出量化方法，直击生成式世界模型用于具身规划的核心痛点。
感知-接触新通道：VibeAct 用振动声学补足视觉遮挡下的灵巧操作；OctoSense 提供多模态机器人感知的开源硬件平台。
